EC1: Contraindications [OR] and/or known hypersensitivity [AND] to the active substance and/or any of the excipients of epoetin beta treatment
EC2: Poorly controlled hypertension as assessed by the investigator
EC3: History of Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) [OR] or high risk for AML
EC4: Administration of another investigational drug within 1 month before screening or planned during the study period
EC5: Previously documented evidence of Pure Red Cell Aplasia (PRCA)
